description.value: Volcanic Hills Estate Winery is a three-generation family estate winery perched on the southeast slope of Mt. Boucherie, a 60-million-year-old dormant volcano whose rich volcanic soils inspired the name. The Gidda family has been growing grapes here since 1978, producing a wide range of wines including whites, reds, icewine, and fruit wines, with tastings available by reservation or walk-in. Seasonal events such as yoga-and-bubbles mornings and wedding hosting make it a lively destination on the Okanagan wine route.
